capabilities: Run code blocks in place with output under the block
Debug Python with breakpoints and stepping
Inspect variables in a variables view
Run MATLAB sessions and other installed language tools
Export notes to Jupyter notebooks and import notebooks and scripts
disambiguation: Not a task or command launcher; it executes code blocks inside notes.
extras: Python on iPhone and iPad is beta and was tested only in Obsidian's mobile mode on a Mac; Linux is untested and Windows is partly tested. Runs programs with the user's own tools and permissions, downloads Pyodide and pip packages only on request, and has no telemetry or accounts. Part of the Tahoe plugin family.
intentEvidence: Execute Code and Tahoe Run do the same core job
problem: Code written in notes cannot be executed, debugged or inspected where it sits, so results and plots end up in a separate app.

relations.evidence: Execute Code and Tahoe Run do the same core job
With Tahoe Code: Python and MATLAB blocks get suggestions from the running session
export a note as a .ipynb notebook (with its outputs and plots)

summary: Runs code blocks in notes in place, with a Python kernel, debugger and variables view, MATLAB sessions, and about 25 other languages.
